name: DQ Marunomi Ryona Battle
original_name: DQ丸呑みリョナ・バトル
source:
Where to she cannot know, What lies in store is unknown,
Deep into the dungeon she goes for a dark illegal battle... 

[from the [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070828.html]English DLsite[/url]]
translation:
不知前路通往何處，也不知那裡有什麼在等著她。她獨自深入地下迷宮，奔赴一場見不得光的非法決鬥……

［摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE070828.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
